body:
Canonical source validation is complete and [PR846](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/846) is merged as `d76c225a0aa741a1a1b0aee707bff328ca467c7c`. [Full source report and reproducibility bundle](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/ca12f5d35214c88533fbdac1effbfc2a362264e8/experiments/2026-10-25_0959_codex_dilution-canonical/README.md).

- The unchanged full default local suite passes **3,571 tests**; format/lint pass without code changes. Hosted units, integration, coverage and docs also pass at the source head.
- Build attempt3 passes in **80.89 s / 1.70 GiB peak RSS**. Independent replay attempt1 passes in **83.24 s / 2.23 GiB**. All original cells (**29,039,248**), numeric comparisons (**297,876**), 15 table counts and metadata/material links reconcile.
- All **61 current release-closure artifacts** verify against published Git bytes. Original/code/configuration hashes and resource limits remain unchanged; refused preflights are preserved.
- [Tested release workflow40197014151](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/actions/runs/40197014151) succeeded on the exact merged main commit. The clean-main publication checkout matches all15pinned implementation files. **[Hitlist2.0.40](https://pypi.org/project/hitlist/2.0.40/) is published**, with both distributions independently compared byte-for-byte to the tested artifacts ([receipt](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/ca12f5d35214c88533fbdac1effbfc2a362264e8/experiments/2026-10-25_0959_codex_dilution-canonical/results/release-2.0.40.json)). No shared environment installation changed.

This completes source conservation, not training admission or biological validation. The next separately registered nominal-dose diagnostic must retain method differences, selected/query-conditioned support, missing feature/link states, nominal-versus-injected amount uncertainty and the limited nine-standard sequence support. No calibrated native/APC concentration or new exact/RL result is claimed.

The [prospective conditional-dose diagnostic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/ca12f5d35214c88533fbdac1effbfc2a362264e8/experiments/agents/codex/plans/dilution-conditional-dose-diagnostic.md) specifies constant, unit-slope, shared-slope and method-slope models with five leave-level-out development folds. Public-API admission and implementation are next; no fit has run. This issue remains open for that recipe/admission scope.
